decision: Rehearsed the live debrief in the same session: other windows, T=7, a changed schedule file and a date shift. The rehearsal found real problems (next two entries). The message was drafted with an outside assistant.
quote: Rehearsal for my live debrief, where I will get a fresh data slice and one new constraint.

decision: Overruled the agent on schedule rows. Its loader let a later effective-date row replace the earlier one, so 5 and 6 Aug fell back to the export baseline, and it called this an undocumented design choice. I required a step function (latest effective_date on or before the trip date). An outside assistant found the flaw; I sent the correction.
quote: Schedule rows must work as a step function

decision: Overruled the agent on output safety: its rejection message printed a raw schedule cell, which breaks my rule that no text from the data appears in tool output. I required reason codes with the route id only. An outside assistant spotted it; I sent the correction.
quote: Tool output must contain no text copied from the data.
